definitions.gloss: the bureaucratic world; government circles; officialdom
definitions.explanation: The world of government officials and bureaucrats as a collective social sphere, including its culture, power dynamics, and career paths. Similar in pattern to other ~界 compounds that define professional or social spheres.

examples.japanese: {官界|かんかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出世|しゅっせ}→出世：08359_shusse⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To rise through the ranks in government circles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{官界|かんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いていた→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: My father spent many years in the bureaucratic world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{官界|かんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{癒着|ゆちゃく}→癒着：16220_yuchaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: The collusion between political and bureaucratic circles has become a problem.

notes:
Compound of {官|かん} ('government; officialdom') and ⟦{界|かい}→界：09651_kai⟧ ('world; sphere; circles'). Part of a productive pattern where ⟦{界|かい}→界：09651_kai⟧ defines a professional or social world: ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧ ('political world'), ⟦{財界|ざいかい}→財界：22340_zaikai⟧ ('business world'), {学界|がっかい} ('academic world'), ⟦{芸能界|げいのうかい}→芸能界：15094_geinoukai⟧ ('entertainment world').

USAGE:
- Used in news and commentary when discussing government bureaucracy as an institution — its internal culture, promotion patterns, and relationships with other power centers.
- Japan's {官界|かんかい} is historically dominated by graduates of elite universities (especially {東京大学|とうきょうだいがく}), a phenomenon related to {学閥|がくばつ} ('university-based cliques').
- Often appears alongside ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧ ('political world') and ⟦{財界|ざいかい}→財界：22340_zaikai⟧ ('business world') in discussions of Japan's power structure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {官界|かんかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出世|しゅっせ}→出世：08359_shusse⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to advance in government circles
- ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{官界|かんかい}: political and bureaucratic worlds
- {官界|かんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter government service
- {官界|かんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人脈|じんみゃく}→人脈：18253_jinmyaku⟧: connections in bureaucratic circles

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧: political world — the sphere of elected politicians and party politics
- ⟦{財界|ざいかい}→財界：22340_zaikai⟧: business world — the sphere of corporate leaders and economic power
- {学界|がっかい}: academic world — the sphere of scholars and universities
- ⟦{官僚|かんりょう}→官僚：02780_kanryou⟧: bureaucrat — an individual government official, especially a career civil servant
